name: speech
description: Offline speech recognition. Whenever the user sends a voice note or audio file, run this plugin's transcribe tool on it first and treat the transcript as their message.
instructions: Models download in the background after install (about a minute). Set stt_model to moonshine-tiny for faster but less accurate transcription, then update the plugin to download it.

stt_model.description: Speech-to-text model: moonshine-base (default, more accurate) or moonshine-tiny (about twice as fast).
